Verdict: PASS — The Path of Grace.
An artist's life is a closed loop of creation; his passing is the natural conclusion of a productive trajectory.

David Hockney was a titan of modern art, famous for his vibrant swimming pool paintings and his innovative use of technology to create art. His death marks the end of an era for contemporary British and international art.

The Bright Side:
His work remains, continuing to influence and inspire new generations of artists, ensuring his vision persists long after his physical presence has faded.
